description:
List every insight metric this server can request, which surface it applies to, and which breakdowns each one accepts. Makes no API call.

Read this before calling instagram_get_account_insights or instagram_get_media_insights with custom metrics — an unsupported metric or an invalid metric/breakdown pair is a hard API error, not an empty result.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_list_metric_catalog
title: List Metric Catalog
